news.title: Warsh's first Jackson Hole address reads hawkish
news.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's debut keynote since taking office leaned firmly on getting inflation back to target. Markets repriced the near-term rate path higher within the hour of the speech.

news.title: Bitcoin loses the $80K level into a heavy options expiry
news.summary: Roughly $6.4B in BTC options expired near that strike the same session, adding pin pressure as spot slipped on the hawkish Fed reaction.

news.title: Solana, Ethereum, and XRP hold up while Bitcoin slips
news.summary: Solana ran as much as +4% intraday (up over 20% on the week), with Ethereum and XRP both holding modest gains even as BTC gave back ground post-speech — a real split within crypto, not a broad risk-off move.

news.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs post an 8-session inflow streak
news.summary: $2.8B moved in over eight straight sessions, the longest run since spring — August is tracking as one of the strongest inflow months since these funds launched.

news.title: Marvell drops on a soft guide, drags semis with it
news.summary: Marvell (MRVL) fell roughly 8% premarket on disappointing guidance, pulling the sector ETF (SMH) down over 1% and Micron (MU) down more than 2%, even as other large-cap chip names held up.

news.title: PayPal loses its takeover premium as talks collapse
news.summary: Reports that Stripe and Advent abandoned their roughly $60.50-a-share acquisition pursuit of PayPal (PYPL) erased the deal premium the stock had been carrying, sending it down double digits.

news.title: Gap and Affirm both beat and raise guidance
news.summary: Gap (GAP) posted a Q2 EPS beat with raised full-year guidance and a new Old Navy CEO; Affirm (AFRM) beat on its fiscal Q4 with strong GMV and user growth. Both jumped double digits premarket.

news.title: Rate-cut odds fade for the next Fed meeting
news.summary: Futures pricing moved meaningfully hawkish over the course of the week as Fed commentary hardened, most notably after the Jackson Hole speech.
